run_get_word_vector_benchmark: run a benchmark that tokenizes data and retrieves word vectors from a fastText model
run_fasttext_word_vector_cli: run the fastText word vector benchmark CLI with a model file and data file as arguments
benchmark_get_word_vector_performance: benchmark the performance of get_word_vector by measuring read time and vectoring time for tokens
review_get_word_vector_function: review the get_word_vector function that tokenizes input data and extracts word vectors using fastText
test_get_word_vector_benchmark: test the get_word_vector benchmark by providing a model file and data file for word vector retrieval
